# Long lines

An unbroken code line, URL, and inline code, each longer than the viewport.

```text
keylight-viewer-check-browser-fixture-without-any-break-opportunity-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
```

```ts
const message = "this TypeScript line is deliberately long so the code block has to scroll inside its own box rather than widen the page around it";
```

A bare URL: https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/keeps/going/without/any/spaces/so/the/paragraph/must/wrap/it/somewhere/sensible/index.html
